 Wilmington actor Nick Basta lends his voice to Grand Theft Auto 6 
 A familiar face in Wilmington’s film and television community can be heard in one of the most anticipated video games. By WECT Staff Published : Nov. 19, 2026 at 6:18 PM EST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google WILMINGTON, N.C. (WECT) - A familiar face in Wilmington’s film and television community can be heard in one of the most anticipated video games.
 Actor Nick Basta did voiceover work for Grand Theft Auto 6 , the highly anticipated latest installment in Rockstar Games’ blockbuster franchise.
 Basta is no stranger to major Hollywood productions. His acting credits include The Hunger Games , Safe Haven and Harriet , along with roles on NBC’s Law & Order: Special Victims Unit and Law & Order: Criminal Intent, FBI International, Florida Man and The Staircase .
 A graduate of Harvard University’s American Repertory Theatre program, Basta also taught theater at the University of North Carolina Wilmington, helping develop the next generation of local performers.
 Audiences can also catch Basta on the big screen at this year’s Cucalorus Film Festival. He appears in Capsized , an independent feature film shot in Wilmington and starring Rhys Ifans and Lily Rabe. The film follows a family facing foreclosure whose patriarch enters a high-stakes fishing tournament in hopes of saving their home.
 Capsized screens Friday, November 20, at 7 p.m. at Thalian Hall in downtown Wilmington.
